div.div: زَجُلٌ زُكَأَةٌ (S, K) and ↓ زُكَأٌ , (K,) and مَلِىْءٌ زُكَأَةٌ (S) and ↓ زُكَأٌ , (TA,) and النَّقْدِ ↓ زُكَآءُ , (S, K,) A wealthy man, quick, or prompt, in paying: (S, * K:) [or rather this is the meaning when you combine the two epithets ملىء and زكأة or زكأ: otherwise the meaning is only a man quick, or prompt, in paying: for] you say, لَتَجِدَنَّهُ زُكَأَةً نُكَأَةً meaning Thou wilt assuredly find him to be one who pays what he owes (TA) without putting off. (K in art. نكأ.)
From An Arabic-English Lexicon (Edward William Lane)
